scenarios.request: full shot down the corridor as Mara walks in
scenarios.why: A full shot named outright; the shot down a corridor is a framing, not gunfire.

scenarios.request: go tight on Joon when he hears the news
scenarios.why: Tight is the close-up: the news lands on his face, nothing else in frame.

scenarios.request: an extreme close-up of Mara's eyes as she lies
scenarios.why: The lie lives in her eyes, so the frame holds only them.

scenarios.request: hold Mara in a wide so she looks small in the empty hall
scenarios.why: A wide lets the empty room swallow her; size is the feeling.

scenarios.request: cowboy framing on Joon for the standoff
scenarios.why: Mid-thigh keeps the holster and the hand in the same frame.

scenarios.request: a medium shot on Mara to keep the talk even
scenarios.why: Waist-up is the neutral distance for ordinary talk.

scenarios.request: head and shoulders on Joon for the interview
scenarios.why: An interview sits on the head-and-shoulders portrait.

scenarios.request: full body on Mara so we see the whole dance
scenarios.why: The dance is in the feet as much as the face: head to toe.

scenarios.request: a choker on Mara for the confession
scenarios.why: A confession presses in: chin to brow, no air around her.

scenarios.request: close-up on Joon as the gunshot rings out
scenarios.why: A camera word beside the gunshot keeps it a camera request.
"In close" is how directors say close-up without the word.
